commands.name: patch-deps
commands.run: for p in patches cli/patches packages/*/patches; do [ -d "$p" ] || continue; (cd "$(dirname "$p")" && npx patch-package) || true; done

setup.name: system
setup.command: curl -fsSL https://deb.nodesource.com/setup_22.x | sudo -E bash - && sudo apt-get install -y nodejs --no-install-recommends && sudo rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/* && sudo npm install -g yarn

setup.name: patch-deps
setup.command: for p in patches cli/patches packages/*/patches; do [ -d "$p" ] || continue; (cd "$(dirname "$p")" && npx patch-package) || true; done
